items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Milt Hinton claims that he did it. ... [INTERVIEWER] Oh Milt, he's just The Judge, he is the main stay of a lot of bands around in New York today, he's one of the great bass players that has played with everybody.

ctx.x: Milt Hinton claims that he did it.
No Milt was down there with us. And so, Diz was sitting--Diz is the one did it. No he wasn't, it
was Jonah, it could have been Milt.
